help.gf2_record_board.py:
usage: gf2_record_board.py [-h] --lille LILLE [--matmulcatalog MATMULCATALOG]
                           [--fmm-repo FMM_REPO] [--fmm-revision FMM_REVISION]
                           [--extra-repo EXTRA_REPO] --witness WITNESS
                           [--cache CACHE] [--jobs JOBS] [--json JSON] [-v]

Scoreboard: best exactly verified local GF(2) witness per shape vs public
ranks.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --lille LILLE
  --matmulcatalog MATMULCATALOG
  --fmm-repo FMM_REPO
  --fmm-revision FMM_REVISION
  --extra-repo EXTRA_REPO
  --witness WITNESS     file or directory (repeatable)
  --cache CACHE         JSON verification cache keyed by SHA-256
  --jobs JOBS           processes for verifying new witness files
  --json JSON           write every row here
  -v, --verbose
help.verify_gf2_lineage.py:
usage: verify_gf2_lineage.py [-h] [--replay-walk REPLAY_WALK]
                             [--replay-max-rank REPLAY_MAX_RANK]
                             [--source SOURCE] [--cache-dir CACHE_DIR]
                             [--repo-root REPO_ROOT] [--no-ruby]
                             bundle

Verify a GF(2) lineage bundle: exact tensors, parent links, replayable steps,
provenance.

positional arguments:
  bundle

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --replay-walk REPLAY_WALK
                        compiled tools/wide_rect_walk.w
  --replay-max-rank REPLAY_MAX_RANK
                        replay only walks whose result has at most this rank
  --source SOURCE       NAME=CLONE for re-derivation
  --cache-dir CACHE_DIR
                        matmulcatalog replay cache
  --repo-root REPO_ROOT
                        checkout root for `retained` rows
  --no-ruby             skip the independent Ruby check
help.screen_public_ternary_gf2.py:
usage: screen_public_ternary_gf2.py [-h] {seeds,walk} ...

Screen public integer-coefficient schemes for GF(2)-only rank reductions.

positional arguments:
  {seeds,walk}
    seeds       convert public integer schemes to exact GF(2) seeds
    walk        directed GF(2) walks from converted seeds

options:
  -h, --help    show this help message and exit
help.screen_public_ternary_gf2.py seeds:
usage: screen_public_ternary_gf2.py seeds [-h] --repo REPO
                                          [--revision REVISION] [--url URL]
                                          --out OUT [--min-dim MIN_DIM]
                                          [--min-max-dim MIN_MAX_DIM]
                                          [--max-dim MAX_DIM]
                                          [--include-rational]
                                          [--alternatives ALTERNATIVES]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO           local (partial) clone in FastMatrixMultiplication
                        format
  --revision REVISION
  --url URL             canonical repository URL recorded in the manifest
  --out OUT             new output directory
  --min-dim MIN_DIM
  --min-max-dim MIN_MAX_DIM
                        skip shapes whose largest side is smaller
  --max-dim MAX_DIM
  --include-rational    also try _Q files; only odd-denominator schemes pass
                        the parity gate
  --alternatives ALTERNATIVES
                        also convert every integer file within best+N
                        (distinct GF(2) seeds only)
help.screen_public_ternary_gf2.py walk:
usage: screen_public_ternary_gf2.py walk [-h] --seeds SEEDS --walker WALKER
                                         --out OUT [--steps STEPS]
                                         [--jobs JOBS] [--repeats REPEATS]
                                         [--nonce-base NONCE_BASE]
                                         [--min-rank MIN_RANK]
                                         [--largest-first]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --seeds SEEDS
  --walker WALKER       compiled tools/wide_rect_walk.w
  --out OUT             JSONL log (appended; finished walks are skipped)
  --steps STEPS
  --jobs JOBS
  --repeats REPEATS     independent nonces per seed
  --nonce-base NONCE_BASE
  --min-rank MIN_RANK
  --largest-first       queue high-rank seeds first
help.mmc_gf2_seeds.py:
usage: mmc_gf2_seeds.py [-h] {targets,replay} ...

matmulcatalog recipes -> exact GF(2) seeds, with attribution.

positional arguments:
  {targets,replay}
    targets         select catalogue schemes worth replaying
    replay          materialize targets over GF(2) into exact seeds

options:
  -h, --help        show this help message and exit
help.mmc_gf2_seeds.py targets:
usage: mmc_gf2_seeds.py targets [-h] --clone CLONE [--revision REVISION]
                                [--cache-dir CACHE_DIR] --lille LILLE
                                [--fmm-repo FMM_REPO]
                                [--fmm-revision FMM_REVISION]
                                [--extra-repo EXTRA_REPO] --board BOARD
                                [--slack SLACK] [--min-dim MIN_DIM] --out OUT

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --clone CLONE         local matmulcatalog clone (a partial clone works)
  --revision REVISION   pinned catalogue revision (recorded per seed)
  --cache-dir CACHE_DIR
  --lille LILLE         fmm_digest fmm_sota.json
  --fmm-repo FMM_REPO   FastMatrixMultiplication clone
  --fmm-revision FMM_REVISION
  --extra-repo EXTRA_REPO
  --board BOARD         scoreboard JSON from gf2_record_board.py --json
  --slack SLACK         also accept ranks up to best listed + SLACK
  --min-dim MIN_DIM
  --out OUT
help.mmc_gf2_seeds.py replay:
usage: mmc_gf2_seeds.py replay [-h] --clone CLONE [--revision REVISION]
                               [--cache-dir CACHE_DIR] --targets TARGETS
                               --out OUT [--board BOARD] [--allow-nonf2]
                               [--retry-failed] [--only [ONLY ...]]
                               [--jobs JOBS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --clone CLONE         local matmulcatalog clone (a partial clone works)
  --revision REVISION   pinned catalogue revision (recorded per seed)
  --cache-dir CACHE_DIR
  --targets TARGETS
  --out OUT
  --board BOARD         scoreboard JSON: exact local witnesses may serve as
                        leaves
  --allow-nonf2         diagnostics: also replay non-F2 schemes
  --retry-failed
  --only [ONLY ...]     canonical shapes or catalogue files to replay
  --jobs JOBS
help.screen_top_two_projection_children.py:
usage: screen_top_two_projection_children.py [-h] (--digest DIGEST |
                                             --replay-manifest REPLAY_MANIFEST)
                                             [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]

Screen a bounded top-two representation beam over exact GF(2) parents. The
external Lille ranks are comparison numbers, not tensor witnesses or a world-
record oracle. Every retained construction is independently replayed.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --digest DIGEST
  --replay-manifest REPLAY_MANIFEST
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR

                                         --replay-manifest REPLAY_MANIFEST)
                                         [--parent-set {structured-projections,first-generation,second-generation,composed-chain,composed-descendants}]
                                         [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]
                                         [--manifest-path MANIFEST_PATH]

Screen exact two-pass basis rewrites and their coordinate projections.

options:

help.screen_neutral_basis_children.py:
usage: screen_neutral_basis_children.py [-h] (--digest DIGEST |
                                        --replay-manifest REPLAY_MANIFEST)
                                        [--depth DEPTH]
                                        [--parent-set {composed-chain,structured-projections}]
                                        [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]

Screen neutral GF(2) matrix-basis rewrites before coordinate deletion. Sources
are the exact composed-parent projection chain. A same-rank basis variant is
useful only if its projected child beats the current closure.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --digest DIGEST
  --replay-manifest REPLAY_MANIFEST
  --depth DEPTH
  --parent-set {composed-chain,structured-projections}
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
help.collect_chains.py:
usage: collect_chains.py [-h] [--shapes SHAPES] [--kinds KINDS]
                         [--max-rank MAX_RANK] [--exclude EXCLUDE]
                         [--budget-mb BUDGET_MB] [--min-steps MIN_STEPS]
                         [--max-steps MAX_STEPS]
                         board out

Reconstruct seed -> projection/basis/walk chains for scoreboard witnesses from
the campaign logs.

positional arguments:
  board
  out

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --shapes SHAPES
  --kinds KINDS
  --max-rank MAX_RANK
  --exclude EXCLUDE     root kinds to skip
  --budget-mb BUDGET_MB
  --min-steps MIN_STEPS
                        skip chains with fewer search steps after the root
  --max-steps MAX_STEPS
                        skip chains with more steps after the root
help.search_wide_projection_walks.py:
usage: search_wide_projection_walks.py [-h] --seed SEED --digest DIGEST
                                       [--walker WALKER]
                                       [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]
                                       [--depth DEPTH] [--beam BEAM]
                                       [--steps STEPS]
                                       [--nonce-base NONCE_BASE] [--list-only]

Bounded exact GF(2) projection/basis/walk search for multiword rectangles.
This cold campaign is separate from the live fleet. Public ranks schedule
walks only; independent full-tensor checks gate every retained result. Shared-
factor pairs route rank ties; density is reported, never routed on.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --seed SEED
  --digest DIGEST       dated rank table for scheduling only
  --walker WALKER
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
  --depth DEPTH
  --beam BEAM
  --steps STEPS
  --nonce-base NONCE_BASE
  --list-only
